messages.author: d643712b18e366a9
messages.subject: Receiving length(uPos) > 0 error when using CytoscanHD data
parts:
I'm trying to process some data from CytoscanHD arrays but run into an error ("Error: length(uPos) > 0 is not TRUE") when trying to process the output from AllelicCrosstalkCalibration. Details, including traceback & sessionInfo below.

I saw a post from another user who received a similar error with SNP6 data. It seemed that the problem in that case was that the user was not using the "Full" version of the SNP cdf file. However, I didn't see a "Full" cdf file in the library files available for CytoscanHD on Affy's website. I'm using ugp, ufl and acs files that I created myself using NetAffx annotation files and instructions from the aroma website.

Will I need to edit the CytoscanHD .cdf? What does the uPos variable refer to? 

Cheers,
David

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Receiving length(uPos) > 0 error when using CytoscanHD data
parts:
Hi David,

it may be that your ACS file (containing probe sequences) is corrupt.  What do you get if you do:

acs <- getAromaCellSequenceFile(cdf);
data <- getSnpNucleotides(acs, verbose=-50);

The you should see what 'uPos' outputs.   It holds the (unique) set of nucleotide positions identified in all probes.  Typically it is position 13 in the 25mers, but for some chip types it is off a few bases for some probes.  However, they should at least have some positions, which is what this internal sanity check is asserting.

/Henrik

I'm trying to process some data from CytoscanHD arrays but run into an error ("Error: length(uPos) > 0 is not TRUE") when trying to process the output from AllelicCrosstalkCalibration. Details, including traceback & sessionInfo below.

I'm using ugp, ufl and acs files that I created myself using NetAffx annotation files and instructions from the aroma website.

Will I need to edit the CytoscanHD .cdf? What does the uPos variable refer to? 

Cheers,
David

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Receiving length(uPos) > 0 error when using CytoscanHD data
parts:
BTW, there is no "full" CDF for this chiptype; Affymetrix provides "only" the CytoScanHD_Array.cdf.  The concept of a "default" and "full" CDF was only for GenomeWideSNP_5 and  GenomeWideSNP_6, which basically because after settling on the chip design, Affymetrix discovered that some probes/SNPs didn't work that well and needed to drop some, resulting in the "default" (where the original was the "full").

/Henrik

I'm trying to process some data from CytoscanHD arrays but run into an error ("Error: length(uPos) > 0 is not TRUE") when trying to process the output from AllelicCrosstalkCalibration. Details, including traceback & sessionInfo below.

I'm using ugp, ufl and acs files that I created myself using NetAffx annotation files and instructions from the aroma website.

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Receiving length(uPos) > 0 error when using CytoscanHD data
parts:
Sorry,

that should have been:

acs <- getAromaCellSequenceFile(cdf);
cells <- getAlleleCellPairs(cdf, verbose=verbose);
data <- getSnpNucleotides(acs, cells=cells, verbose=-50);

Look for the "Unique SNP positions:" output.

parts:
Yes,

it should be alright to those annotation data files I've placed on

http://aroma-project.org/data/annotationData/chipTypes/CytoScanHD_Array/

The attached plot is a proof of concept using an example data set from
Affymetrix.

FYI, *.acs (and *.ugp, and *.ufl) files are binary files, so I doubt
'wc' is inappropriate to use. Instead you can use, say,
readSequences(acs, cells=1010:1015) to retrieve the probe sequences
and hence compare them with those of another file.

/Henrik
